Job Vacancies

You are here | Home | About | Job Vacancies

The RNCM is recognised as one of the world’s most forward-thinking and dynamic conservatoires, educating musicians to the highest level in an environment that’s creatively stimulating and rich in opportunity. 

With the support of a friendly community of loyal staff, our students are inspired to become the next generation of musicians, working hard to develop their talent and embrace new skills for exciting futures on and off stage. 

Could you be part of our story?

We offer a range of roles at various levels within our Academic and Professional Services areas, including Teaching and Research, Marketing and Communications, Development, Conference and Catering, Finance, Human Resources, Performance and Programming, and Estates and Operations.  

Browse our current vacancies to see if applying to the RNCM is right for you.  

Our Commitment

We’re committed to encouraging diversity across the organisation and our aim, where possible, is to be representative of all sections of society, ensuring that everyone feels respected and able to give their best.  

We’re also committed to paying the real living wage rate of pay for all employees and casual workers and strive to provide an efficient and professional recruitment and selection service, incorporating appropriate levels of support to prospective employees. To read more about the benefits of working with us, see our Staff Benefits page. 

Please view our Safeguarding information.
